from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    stamp_color=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==stamp_color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in points); r1=max(r for r,c in points)
    c0=min(c for r,c in points); c1=max(c for r,c in points)
    stamp=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in points]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in stamp):
                for dr,dc in stamp:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc]=stamp_color
    return out
